sources.claim: AI EDA market to reach USD 15.85 billion by 2032 with a 24.4% CAGR — market valued at $4.27B in 2026
sources.notes: MarketsandMarkets report published July 2026. Primary source for market size and CAGR figures.

sources.claim: Synopsys (31%) and Cadence (30%) lead AI EDA market; top 5 players control 70–85% of total market share
sources.notes: Company landscape report with verified market share breakdown. Includes Siemens EDA (13%), Keysight, Zuken.

sources.claim: AlphaChip generates superhuman chip layouts in hours vs. weeks; deployed in Alphabet production chips; pre-trained checkpoint released publicly September 2024
sources.notes: Official Google DeepMind blog post. Primary source for AlphaChip claims and timeline.

sources.claim: Cognichip raises $60M Series A; claims 75% cost reduction and 50% timeline compression via physics-informed AI chip design
sources.notes: TechCrunch coverage of April 2026 funding round. Revenue/impact figures are company claims, not independently verified.

sources.claim: Ricursive Intelligence: $335M funding total (Sequoia seed Dec 2025 + Lightspeed $300M Series A), $4B valuation. Cognichip: $93M total. Normal Computing: $85M. Vinci: $46M.
sources.notes: Industry tracker with confirmed funding round details for EDA AI startups as of Q1 2026.

sources.claim: Agentic AI in EDA is receiving substantial investment; ChipAgents represents the shift toward fully autonomous chip design pipelines
sources.notes: Video interview with CEO of ChipAgents confirming agentic EDA market direction.

sources.claim: EDA software subject to US export controls; BIS levied $140M+ penalties in July 2025 for illegal EDA exports to China; US export controls temporarily targeted EDA tools during 2025 trade negotiations
sources.notes: CSIS policy analysis. Primary source for regulatory/legal claims.

sources.claim: Cadence launches Cerebrus AI Studio (May 2025): industry's first agentic multi-block AI design platform; 5x faster SoC time-to-market; 1,000+ tapeouts completed; 50+ new customers Q1 2025
sources.notes: Industry publication covering Cadence launch. Customer metrics from Cadence official press release.

sources.claim: Cadence Cerebrus achieves up to 10x productivity improvement and up to 20% PPA gain; Samsung used Cerebrus to achieve 8% power reduction; Imagination Technologies cut leakage power by 20%
sources.notes: Customer results from 2024 industry report. Individual customer outcomes are verified from Cadence case studies.

sources.claim: AI fuels $24 billion chip design market; industry sales growing at 11.8% CAGR through decade's end; Synopsys-Ansys $35B acquisition completed; Renesas acquired Altium for $5.9B
sources.notes: Bloomberg market analysis. Synopsys FY2024 revenue of $6.127B and 15% growth confirmed in earnings reports.
